AACT.description: Al Anwar Ceramic Tiles Company SAOG, established in 1998 in Nizwa, is Oman's first ceramic tile manufacturer and one of the top three ceramic producers in the GCC. Operating five production lines equipped with Italian digital printing technology (55,000 SQM/day installed capacity) and the region's largest third-firing decorative unit, the company manufactures glazed ceramic and porcelain wall, floor, exterior, and decorative tiles. Its flagship 'Al Shams' brand holds market leadership in Oman and exports to over 20 countries across the Middle East and Africa, recently complemented by a new premium 'KASSIA' product line.
businessHighlights: Nine-month 2026 revenue increased 8.5% year-on-year to OMR 15.28 million while net profit after tax nearly doubled (+99%) to OMR 944 thousand on strong domestic Omani volume growth.
Scaled its Nizwa manufacturing complex from one line (6,000 SQM/day) to five lines with 55,000 SQM/day installed capacity plus the region's largest third-firing decorative unit.
Launched the new premium 'KASSIA' tile brand to reinforce domestic market leadership alongside flagship 'Al Shams' while navigating regional export freight headwinds.

Expanding rapidly across its balance sheet, ahlibank reached OMR 4.62B in total assets and OMR 3.86B in net loans, advances, and Islamic financing as of September 2026. Disciplined cost management and broad customer franchise growth underpin its consistent earnings trajectory.

AFAI.description: Al Fajar Al Alamia Co. AFIC.description: Arabia Falcon Insurance Company SAOG (AFIC) is a Muscat-based composite insurer formed through the merger of two Omani insurance businesses, drawing on more than 70 years of regional underwriting heritage. The company writes personal and corporate general insurance—principally Motor and Property & Casualty lines—alongside Life and Unified Credit Life policies, supported by an investment portfolio that contributes a substantial share of net earnings. Its core Contracting Services business operates through wholly owned subsidiary Draieh Catering Services Co. LLC, feeding and housing personnel across remote oil and gas fields, industrial sites, military and defense forces, hospitals, and educational institutions. ATMI.description: Al Jazeera Steel Products Co. BATP.description: Al Batinah Power Company SAOG owns and operates the Sohar-2 Independent Power Project (IPP), a modern gas-fired power plant situated inside Sohar Industrial Port roughly 200 km northwest of Muscat. Fuel and energy charges are contractually passed through to gas and O&M suppliers, insulating core profitability while high thermal efficiency (98.75%) keeps Sohar-2 near the top of Oman's dispatch merit order. Following the execution of a new PPA in 2026, the plant continues to anchor industrial power supply in the Sohar hub.
